mapper.select: SELECT ID, USER_ID, NICKNAME, NAME, GENDER, PHONE, EMAIL, BIRTHDATE, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DETAIL, ZIPCODE, REFUND_ACCOUNT, REFUND_BANK FROM CUSTOMER_TB WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CUSTOMER_TB (USER_ID, NICKNAME, NAME, GENDER, PHONE, EMAIL, BIRTHDATE, ADDRESS, ADDRESS_DETAIL, ZIPCODE) VALUES (#{userId}, #{nickname}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{birthDate}, #{address}, #{addressDetail}, #{zipcode})
mapper.select: SELECT o.ID as orderId, o.ORDER_DATE as orderDate, os.ORDER_STATUS as orderStatus, o.TOTAL_AMOUNT as totalAmount, od.UNIT_PRICE as unitPrice, od.DISCOUNT_PRICE as discountPrice, od.QUANTITY as quantity, os.DESCRIPTION as deliveryStatus, 'dummy_carrier' as carrier, 'dummy_tracking_number' as trackingNumber, CURRENT_DATE as estimatedArrivalDate FROM ORDER_TB o JOIN ORDER_DETAIL_TB od ON o.ID = od.ORDER_ID JOIN ORDER_STATUS_TB os ON o.ID = os.ORDER_ID WHERE o.IDENTIFIER_ID = #{customerId} AND o.ORDER_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY o.ORDER_DATE DESC
